assessment.result: Actual StaticUtf8 is the only new producer of the private Static root. Both kernels bound byte length and validate UTF8 before module hashing; Analyze checks the exact immutable Address<Slice<U8>> result in preflight and Verify derives that exact expected type independently. Names, spans, candidate roots and exported static_storage metadata cannot produce a root.

Independent FIFO versus batched return-frontier solvers start from empty per-function summaries and use only reachable actual returns. Static roots are preserved alongside actual parameter roots. Empty recursive results remain rejected by independent grounding checks. Filtering activation-local roots out of a callee public summary does not bypass the callee own return-escape checks.

The dedicated instruction cannot return a mutable address. Static provenance follows address loads, reborrows, index/slice projections and actual call substitutions; the new final mutable-value check rejects Static even without a write. Verify also keeps its ordinary exact operand/result and shared-to-exclusive checks. Stored transfer and actual access checks separately reject Static mutation.

Stored transfer introduces the actual static pointer target, preserves it through payload copies and actual call substitution, and permits it as an outliving shared result. Static cannot supply nested carrier slots or forged projected summaries: select and instantiate/substitute reject those shapes. A local containing a static pointer is distinct from the local slot address; StorageDead retires the slot rather than the static backing data. Head/resource separation does not treat Static as an external owner slot.

Analyze input reserves two byte traversals plus UTF8 validation and Verify reserves validation plus streaming module fingerprinting before inspecting the payload. Bounds reject oversized raw vectors before hashing. New root unions/copies, mutable qualification and stored permission operations use the current request ledger. The static presence bit is derived only from the raw instruction inventory and enables extra checks; it is not authority. AnalysisSession still runs preflight and provenance fresh before/after reusing only initialization projections, with a new request budget. Default limits were not raised.

result_has_static_origin reads only the sealed checked module/plan. result_origins continues to expose real parameter positions separately, so a real Static plus Parameter union does not become a fake parameter-only or empty relation. The Boolean observation is not consumed by either kernel as a permission source.
